nodes.description: Private address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor; used as privileged check in approveAndCall, transferownership and ensure.
Public mapping of user balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Public nested mapping of allowances, written in approve and decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Address set by transferownership that bypasses the sale-condition checks in ensure.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted by approveAndCall to bypass the sale condition.
Number of allowed sales per account used in the condition check.
Minimum amount allowed per transfer in condition.
Maximum amount allowed per transfer in condition.
Counter of sales performed per account, incremented on each transferFrom and read in ensure/condition.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used for supply and balance scaling.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom that checks allowance, applies ensure/condition, and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view guard returning true for owner, tradeAddress or whitelisted senders, otherwise enforcing condition.
Internal view sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
Owner-only function that sets balanceOf[spender] using unchecked multiplication and whitelists the spender.
Owner-only function that sets tradeAddress, granting a conditional bypass.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for authorization, allowance and ownership assignment.
